context.transcript:
This is Scott Durlin, and you're listening to Scott's Money Advice on WYBR Radio 91, where we discuss how to handle all types of money and home budget topics.
I want to let listeners know that as of today, you can download audio files of past broadcasts of our show from my newly updated website, www.scottsadvice.com.
This is in addition to the usual links and interactive features on topics from the show, and I always like to hear from you.
So please email me any money questions you might have.
I'll be sure to answer them on the air.
Now let's return to our discussion of what to do when buying a car with our guest, Nina Robinson.
context.transcript_translation:
我是 Scott Durlin，您正在收听 WYBR Radio 91 的《Scott's Money Advice》，在这里我们讨论如何处理所有类型的金钱和家庭预算话题。
我想让听众知道，从今天起，您可以从我的新更新的网站 www.scottsadvice.com 下载我们节目过往广播的音频文件。
这除了节目上通常提供的链接和互动功能之外，我一直很喜欢听到您的声音。
所以请把您任何关于金钱的问题通过电子邮件发给我。
我一定会在直播中回答它们。
现在让我们回到与我们的嘉宾 Nina Robinson 一起讨论购买汽车时该做什么的话题。
